title: 第1章 大雪第2章 宝鱼第3章 求武
content_zh:
小寒城。
寒风凛冽，大雪纷飞。
傍晚时分，外城棚户区，一座漏风的土坯屋舍内，几道人影围在一盆微弱的炭火旁，炭火烧得噼啪作响，却驱不散刺骨的寒意。
“这雪下得邪性，怕是要比往年更久些。”
陆老头抽着旱烟，烟杆里的火星明灭不定，眉头皱成了川字，“再这么下去，别说取暖的柴火，连过冬的口粮都要断了。”
他身旁的陆磐石叹了口气，搓了搓冻得通红的手：“每年雪期都得两三个月，今年这场雪下得猛，怕是要冻死人了。”
“二哥进山都两天了，会不会……”陆元鸿话到嘴边又咽了回去，眼神里藏着担忧。
角落里，陆沉蜷缩着身子，将几人的对话听得分明。
穿越到这个世界已有数日，他一直保持着沉默，一边梳理原主的记忆，一边观察着这个陌生的世界。
他今年十三岁，是陆家二房的独子。
陆家尚未分户，爷爷陆老头是一家之主，育有三子：大伯陆磐石、父亲陆恒阳，还有眼前这位三叔陆元鸿。
此世的凉国地处北境，常年寒风凛冽，一到冬季更是大雪封山。
若是没有足够的柴火取暖，冻死人是常有的事。可山中天寒地冻，偶尔还有异兽出没，冬季入山凶险至极。
昨日清晨，为了储备过冬的薪柴，父亲陆恒阳不得不冒雪进山砍柴，如今迟迟未归，让一家人的心都悬了起来。
“不能再等了，得派人去找找。”陆老头将烟杆在鞋底磕了磕，起身道：“趁天还没黑透，我们进山看看。”
“爹，我和老三去就行。”陆磐石连忙拦住他：“您年纪大了，进山太危险。”
就在这时，屋外传来一阵沉重的脚步声，伴随着狼犬的低吠。
众人抬头望去，只见风雪中，一道高大的身影正和三头狼犬一起，费力地拉着一橇柴火而来——正是陆沉的父亲陆恒阳。
“老二！”
“二哥！”

众人喜出望外，连忙冲出去帮忙，陆沉的娘亲张氏端来一碗的热水。
陆恒阳也不怕烫，接过一饮而尽，龇牙咧嘴道：“昨晚雪太大，我在山神庙里宿了一夜，今天想着多砍些，省得再跑一趟。”
众人松了口气，脸上露出些许笑意。
这一车柴火都是深山里的上好硬木，足够解燃眉之急了。
可没等他们高兴多久，外面又传来了脚步声。
几个穿着厚棉袄的人走了过来，为首的是个高大壮汉，脸上带着倨傲的笑容：“陆老二，你可算回来了。”
“赵三爷。”陆老头连忙迎上去，语气带着几分拘谨，“您怎么来了？今年的炭奉，我们已经送过去了啊。”
赵三爷是裂石帮的头目，裂石帮是棚户区的黑道帮派，帮众不下百人，平日里欺压百姓，对贫民吃拿卡要。
赵三爷在帮中排行第三，是实打实的明劲武者，等闲十几个壮汉都近不了他的身。
陆家三兄弟虽是青壮，却也不敢得罪他。
赵三爷扫了一眼那车柴火，咧嘴一笑：“我们帮主纳了第五房小妾，你家的炭奉也该多孝敬点，这一车柴火就当是给帮主的贺礼吧。”
“来人，把柴火拖走。”
他一挥手，身后的帮众就要上前。
陆老头脸色大变，连忙阻拦：“三爷，这柴火是我们过冬用的，不能……”
赵三爷冷哼一声，挥袖一甩，陆老头就被摔了出去。
“爹！”
陆家众人慌忙上前，将陆老头扶起来。
好在地上有厚厚的积雪，陆老头没受重伤，只是脸色苍白。
content_en:
Xiaohan City.
The wind is freezing and the snow is falling heavily.
In the evening, in a drafty adobe house in a shanty town in the outer city, several figures gathered around a weak pot of charcoal fire. The charcoal fire crackled but could not dispel the biting chill.
"The snow is so evil that it may last longer than in previous years."
Old Man Lu was smoking a dry cigarette. The sparks in the cigarette stick flickered and flickered. His brows furrowed into the Chinese character "Sichuan". "If this continues, not to mention the firewood for heating, even the winter rations will be cut off."
Lu Panshi next to him sighed and rubbed his hands that were red from the cold: "The snow season lasts for two to three months every year. This year, the snow is so fierce that I'm afraid people will freeze to death."
"Second brother has been in the mountains for two days, could it be..." Lu Yuanhong swallowed the words as he spoke, with worry hidden in his eyes.
In the corner, Lu Chen curled up and could clearly hear the conversation of several people.
It has been several days since he traveled to this world, and he has remained silent, observing this strange world while sorting out the memories of the original owner.
He is thirteen years old and the only son of the second wife of the Lu family.
The Lu family has not yet been divided. Grandfather Lu is the head of the family and has three sons: uncle Lu Panshi, father Lu Hengyang, and third uncle Lu Yuanhong.
The Liang Kingdom in this world is located in the north. It is always cold and windy, and in winter the mountains are covered with heavy snow.
If there is not enough firewood for heating, it is common for people to freeze to death. However, it is freezing cold in the mountains, and strange animals occasionally appear. It is extremely dangerous to enter the mountains in winter.
Yesterday morning, in order to store firewood for the winter, his father Lu Hengyang had to go into the mountains to cut firewood in the snow. Now that he has not returned, the family is worried.
"We can't wait any longer. We have to send someone to look for him." Old Man Lu knocked his cigarette stick on the sole of his shoe, stood up and said, "Let's go into the mountain to take a look before it gets dark."
"Dad, the third child and I can go." Lu Panshi stopped him quickly: "You are old and it is too dangerous to go into the mountains."
At this moment, there was a sound of heavy footsteps outside the house, accompanied by the low barking of a wolf dog.
Everyone looked up and saw a tall figure in the wind and snow, together with three wolf dogs, laboriously pulling a sled of firewood - it was Lu Chen's father, Lu Hengyang.
"Dick!"
"Second brother!"
Everyone was overjoyed and rushed out to help. Lu Chen's mother, Mrs. Zhang, brought a bowl of hot water.
Lu Hengyang was not afraid of burning it, so he took it and drank it down in one gulp. He grinned and said, "It snowed too much last night, so I stayed overnight in the mountain temple. I want to chop more today to avoid having to make another trip."
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief, with some smiles on their faces.
This load of firewood is all the best hardwood from the mountains, which is enough to meet the urgent needs.
But before they could be happy for long, there were footsteps again outside.
Several people wearing thick cotton-padded jackets came over. The leader was a tall and strong man with a haughty smile on his face: "Lu Laoer, you are back."
"Mr. Zhao." Old Man Lu hurriedly greeted him with a somewhat reserved tone, "Why are you here? We have already delivered this year's charcoal gift."
Mr. Zhao Sanye is the leader of the Split Stone Gang, a gang in the shanty towns. There are no less than a hundred members in the gang. They bully the people on weekdays and take advantage of the poor.
Mr. Zhao ranks third in the gang and is a solid martial artist. Even a dozen strong men can't get close to him.
Although the three Lu brothers were young and strong, they did not dare to offend him.
Mr. Zhao glanced at the cart of firewood and grinned: "Our gang leader has taken in a concubine in the fifth house. Your family's charcoal should be more filial. This cart of firewood should be regarded as a congratulatory gift to the gang leader."
"Someone, drag the firewood away."
He waved his hand, and the gang behind him would step forward.
Old Man Lu's expression changed greatly, and he quickly stopped him: "Third Master, this firewood is for us to spend the winter, we can't..."
Mr. Zhao snorted coldly, waved his sleeves, and old man Lu was thrown out.
"Dad!"
Everyone in the Lu family hurriedly stepped forward and helped Old Lu up.Fortunately, there was thick snow on the ground, and Old Man Lu was not seriously injured, but his face was pale.
